subject.title: fix(agents): use currentAttemptAssistant for incomplete-turn classification

question: Is source-level terminal proof plus regression coverage sufficient to merge this classifier-only delivery-path fix, or should this PR wait for live WhatsApp/OpenRouter transport proof?
rationale: The patch is narrow and source-backed, but it changes terminal message-delivery classification and the contributor did not run the full live channel scenario from the linked report.

options.title: Accept Source-Level Proof
options.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers accept the before/after fixture and regression tests as sufficient for this classifier-only fix.

options.title: Require Live Transport Proof
options.body: Pause until a redacted configured-channel run shows an `update_plan` turn followed by a `stopReason=stop` final answer delivers the final text.

recommendation.title: Accept Source-Level Proof
recommendation.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers accept the before/after fixture and regression tests as sufficient for this classifier-only fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The earliest traced incomplete-turn classifier ownership and replay-state consolidation point to this person as the best available proof-bar decision owner.
